activity.notes: Karl XI succeeded as King of Sweden in 1660 and reigned until 1697. Because he was a child at accession, a regency governed during his minority until 1672, but his sovereign reign itself remained continuous; ATLAS therefore preserves the conventional 1660–1697 regnal interval.

sources.title: The monarchy of Sweden — The Royal Court of Sweden
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court of Sweden lists Karl XI as reigning from 1660 to 1697.

sources.title: Monarkins historia — Kungahuset
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court explains that Karl XI succeeded in 1660 as a four-year-old and that a regency governed until his majority in 1672.
